g.data-semantic-relation: prepare box candidates, prototypes and coefficients before composing a mask
g.data-must-show: backbone/neck 分支為 dense box/class head | 共享 prototype masks | 另有每個 instance coefficients
g.data-not-claim: prototype basis 本身不是某一個物件的最終 mask。
g.title: box candidates 與 mask ingredients

g.data-semantic-relation: suppress overlapping instances before mask composition
g.data-must-show: 許多候選框經 decode | confidence filter | NMS | 留下兩個不同顏色 instance boxes
g.data-not-claim: 被 NMS 壓掉的候選不能再由 mask head 自動救回。
